name: Weinheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue, charged at the centre with the city arms of Weinheim (a red lion on yellow, blue and white lozenges, and a yellow ladder on red).
history: Municipal flag of Weinheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Weinheim arms — lion, lozenges and ladder
